resources.string: Balances are worked out from what you enter. Check them against your bank. We are not responsible for decisions made from them.
If %1$s has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check Spam and Promotions too.
If you report a person, we keep your reason and the chat reference so the problem can be reviewed.
In your private area of Google Firebase (Firestore, Storage and Authentication). Only you can read your money data.
Keep your login safe. You can delete your account at any time from Settings.

Messages and photos are visible only to the people in that chat. Chat is protected by access rules on the server, not by end-to-end encryption, so do not share secrets such as card numbers or passwords.
No harassment, spam, or illegal content. We may remove content or accounts that break these rules.
Questions about privacy can be sent to the developer, KDevs, through the Spendly page on the store.
Recording a settlement in a group only notes that a payment happened. Pay people yourself, outside the app.
Bring banks, wallets, cash and cards together and see what you really have.
Set limits for each category and save towards what matters, with progress at a glance.
Amount, category, done. Repeats handle the usual ones.
Clear reports by category and trend show what to cut and what to keep.
Chat one to one or in groups and settle shared bills without the awkward maths.
Spendly helps you record and understand your spending. It is a personal tool, not a bank, and it never moves real money.
We may update the app and these terms. Major changes will be shown in the app.
You can change your name, sign out, or delete everything from Settings. Deleting removes your data and your login for good.
Your friend code lets people send you a request. They see your display name, nothing else. You can block anyone from Chat settings.
Your name and email when you sign up, and the accounts, transactions, budgets, goals and chats you add.
